unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Figure 2 and Figure 3 are bar graphs without embedded numeric data labels for every bar. Exact bar heights would require estimation/digitization, so only text-supported inequalities and figure-label values are asserted.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: No exact graph-only bar values were fabricated; Table 1, source text, and Fig. 4 label values cover the final activity/toxicity claims used for acceptance.
